in_sanskrit.name: Sejad
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise, Sage, Leader
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sejad एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sejad is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sage' or 'wise'. It is a name for a leader or a wise man. It is also associated with water and rivers, symbolizing the flow of knowledge and understanding.
